name: maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecord
signature: void maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecord(void* group, u32 flags, int extra)
summary: Scans the four battle unit rings at +0x428C, clears f_79 on found actors, and submits a 9-word member-id record through the group's virtual +0x60.
evidence: Group layout and virtual +0x60 match the named field-party group; no direct callers, so the field-party attribution stays tentative.

name: maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecordAlt
signature: void maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecordAlt(void* group, u32 flags, int slot)
summary: Same 16-slot scan and record layout as 0x001FC95C but the per-slot id comes from group virtual +0x4C and the record is pushed through the global window object.
evidence: Same callee set and group layout as 0x001FC95C; no direct caller, so the variant wording is kept.

name: maybe_Battle_IncrementUnitCounters
summary: Walks the four 0x1C-stride battle unit rings and increments a capped per-unit counter at saveWork+0x3AE4+id*4 for live units without flag bits 0x46.
evidence: Callee 0x00612A94 does the per-id increment with the 99999 cap; list offsets are the documented battle-work unit tables.

name: maybe_Menu_InitBaseEffectParams
summary: Resets cursor id f_4211 to 0xFF, creates the five shared effect parameters (0x13/0x15/0x14/9/10) on the menu effect owner, flushes them and requests the category BGM.
evidence: Exactly the first five Gfx_EffectParams_Create ids and the f_4211 reset of the named Menu_Status_InitEffectParams; no callers.

name: maybe_Menu_MeasureAverageActorWidthTail
summary: False function entry inside Menu_MeasureAverageActorWidth (0x0020BFF0); the repeated Gfx_EffectParams_Create calls are Ghidra decoding the middle of the measure loop.
evidence: No prologue at 0x0020C08C, loop branch jumps back into 0x0020BFF0, and the enclosing function pops at 0x0020C0C0.

name: maybe_Menu_WriteEffectStateByte
signature: void maybe_Menu_WriteEffectStateByte(MenuState* self, u8 value, int offset)
summary: Stores one byte at self+offset and appends the standard four-entry menu effect-parameter block (8/10, 0/0x6F, 7/0, 2/0) to the menu effect owner at self+0x4D78.
evidence: Write is *(u8*)(offset+self)=value with the same +0x4D78 effect-owner offset used by named menu effect init routines; no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_CloseScreenOnButton
summary: Per-frame screen tick: when func_0066D1C0 finds a slot with resource byte +0x78 == 4, re-binds scene-flow slot resources and requests animation 9 (back/close) on the screen animator; always returns 1.
evidence: 0x0066D1C0 walks the core slot tables testing byte +0x78 == 4; Ui_SceneFlow_BindSlotResources and animation id 9 are the only certain parts.

name: maybe_Field_InitDescriptorFromConst
signature: void maybe_Field_InitDescriptorFromConst(u32 actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
summary: Copies the 24-word constant block at 0x007291F0 onto the stack and sets a state byte (2 when the 50-entry named-row table still has a free row, else 3); the entry point is half bad-instruction data.
evidence: First half flagged halt_baddata; surviving code is Game_GetWork -> 0x0066B1FC(work+0x24A98) -> state 2/3 plus a 24-word copy of 0x007291F0.

name: maybe_Ui_Node_SetPackedEntryValue
summary: Stores (value & 0xFFFF0000) | 0xFFFF into self+0x11C, zeroes +0x120, and forwards the value to the linked battle-info object at +0xE4 and HP object at +0xF0.
evidence: Body matches the documented packed-entry store and the two conditional forwards to Ui_DungeonBattleWindow_SetInfo / Ui_DungeonHpWindow_SetValue; only caller is Field2D_SpriteNode_DispatchDraw, so the owning class is still unclear.

name: maybe_Ui_TwoPageListWindow_Init
signature: void maybe_Ui_TwoPageListWindow_Init(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Resets the first row anim, fills two rows from the static id table via func_002BCFF4/func_001A6680, and clamps the selection; called from Ui_EquipmentWindow_Update.
evidence: Single caller Ui_EquipmentWindow_Update; body uses g_uiTwoChoiceCategoryIndices and the same helper pair as the SetPage sibling; no symbol names the window class.

name: maybe_Ui_TwoPageListWindow_SetPage
summary: Switches the list between page 0 (four ids from the table) and page 1 (five ids), resetting the corresponding anim and clamping the selection.
evidence: Same caller and table as 0x00214AA0; page sizes 4 and 5 are certain but the owning window class is inferred.

evidence: Callees Pack_Handle_Dtor, Actor_HandleRefEx_DtorDelete and Actor2D_EffectNode_DeletingDtor match the documented template; no callers listed, so the class identity stays inferred.

name: Actor2D_HandleObject_DeletingDtor

name: maybe_Anim_Timeline_IsIdActive
summary: Looks id up in the data-manager 0x0063E340 table (column chosen by self+8) and returns whether the resulting index (<0xA5) has its bit set in the 0xA5-bit mask at self+0xE0.

name: maybe_Actor_UpdateModelIfReady
summary: Per-frame scene-object tick: when the object owns a model (word +0x56) and Ui_Span_IsIdle reports the referenced parts idle, re-dispatches its own vtable+8 update; always returns 1.
evidence: Callee 0x00641960 is Ui_Span_IsIdle; vtable+8 target unidentified and no named caller.

name: maybe_Ui_DeactivateAttachedWidget
summary: Hides the attached child widget at owner+4 via Ui_TitleWindow_SetButtonVisible(child,0) and clears the child's active byte +0x94; frees nothing.
evidence: Caller Ui_TalkWindow_ReleaseResources uses it to stop the second animated part; callee only toggles visible/active flags; exact widget class unknown.

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ClearQuestStateByte
signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_ClearQuestStateByte(u32 index, u32 kind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Scene-object command: forwards to children, then for kind 3 maps index through a u16 lookup and writes 0xFF (unset) into GameWork+0x24A98+0x5A4E+id, the shared pastword/quest id block.
evidence: Store address 0x2A4E6 = work+0x24A98+0x5A4E (pastword/quest table); lookup base literal is only 0x34A so that branch may be dead.

name: maybe_Actor_OnPlayEvent
summary: Forwards the event to child scene nodes, then for event 5 on an idle actor with unset f_2EC copies the global default class id into f_2F0 and latches f_2EC.
evidence: Only callee is Field_SceneNode_ForwardCommand; event 5 meaning and the global at 0x007A3F6C remain unidentified, so the name stays a guess.

name: maybe_Actor_ResetIdleAnimAndTrail
summary: Selects an idle/standby animation (0x1B or 4/5/1 depending on state) and resets the trail sample record via Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples.
evidence: Calls Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples and Actor_ResolveReferenceObject, and picks animation ids; caller ModelPreview_UpdateAttachments is consistent but the exact standby semantics are unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Ui_FrameScript_Update
summary: Generic per-frame step driver: advances the 1/30 s timer, dispatches the current 0x18-byte callback record from the table at +0x11C (limit 0x16), and rebuilds the shared core object when the +0x11DA latch is set.
evidence: Same 0x18-byte step-record pattern as the other Ui update drivers; only caller is maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_Ctor and no vtable slot ties it to a concrete screen.

name: Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateAnimation
summary: Per-frame driver of the dive-window animator: advances the 1/30 s timer, dispatches the current 0x18-byte step record while +0x134 < 0x0B, and clears the UI input-mode word when the +0x264 latch is set.
evidence: Vtable neighbours include Ui_DiveWindow_DtorDeleteAlt, Ui_DiveWindow_InitPanes and maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_ApplyChildState, fixing the class; body is the generic step driver.

name: Ui_DungeonWindow_Update
summary: Per-frame update of the dungeon window: runs the base virtual +0x2C, releases sub-widgets, advances the five-slot timer array by 1/30 s, fires the armed timer callback and clears the rebuild byte at +0x4FD4.
evidence: Calls maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseSubWidgets and sits in the Ui_DungeonWindow_* vtable row; 1/30 s constant and 5 x 0x18 timer slots visible.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateNextArrow
summary: Timer-driven layout animation: while the window reports not busy via virtual +0x4C, subtracts the 1/30 s frame delta from the float timer at +0x188 and, when it crosses zero, clamps to -1 and tail-calls the layout anim on the child at +0x13C.
evidence: Vtable neighbours include Ui_MessageWindow_LoadLayout and Ui_MessageWindow_ReleaseBase; the arrow/next-indicator semantics are inferred from the timer+layout-anim pattern only.

name: maybe_Ui_WindowStateSlot_Step
summary: Advances a window's two-entry state queue: adds the 1/30 s frame delta to the slot timer, bumps the frame counter, and invokes the callback selected by +0x360 through the 0x18-byte entry and the adjustor table at +0x37C.
evidence: Vtable neighbour maybe_Ui_WindowStateSlot_DispatchPending and the shared 0x18-byte step-record dispatch; concrete class still unknown.

name: Ui_KyoukaiWindow_UpdateAnimation
summary: Frame update: accumulates the 1/30 s frame delta and, while the active slot index at +0xD90 is below 8, dispatches that slot's callback from the 0x18-byte entry using the dispatch table at +0xDAC.
evidence: Vtable neighbours Ui_KyoukaiWindow_CreatePanes and maybe_Ui_KyoukaiWindow_UpdateB fix the class; body is the generic 0x18-byte step driver with limit 8.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageCmd_UpdateQueue
summary: Frame update of a message-command window controller: accumulates the 1/30 s delta and dispatches the callback of the active slot (index < 9) from the 0x18-byte entry table.
evidence: Owner class still ambiguous (table at 0x00768BEC mixes message-command and three-row text windows); dispatch through slot entry +0x34/+0x38 with table at +0xDAC is clear but class-specific naming unsupported.

name: maybe_ModelPreview_SelectAttachmentSlot
signature: void maybe_ModelPreview_SelectAttachmentSlot(GfxSubObject* self, const u8* slot, u8 value)
summary: Selects the model-preview attachment for a slot: refreshes if the slot already holds the expected attachment id, otherwise creates it from the 12-entry name table and records the slot index.
evidence: Body damaged (unaff_r5/unaff_r6, iStack_1c) and no callers; callees ModelPreview_CreateAttachments/UpdateAttachments and f_278 slot index support the subsystem only.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_RegisterSceneNode
summary: Resolves the scene-node handle at self+0x4C and, when it yields a node, registers it with the field object manager by class.
evidence: Callee Field_ObjectManager_RegisterByClass is named; handle source 0x005F2EC8 unnamed and owner class unverified, so maybe_ stays.

name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_SetStateByte
summary: Stores a state byte at self+0xC1C and broadcasts message 8 to group 0 of the field object manager's object lists.
evidence: Callee Ui_Widget_DispatchToGroupedChildren(8,0) named; object class unverified and Ghidra swapped args, so maybe_ stays.

name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_SetStateByteB
summary: Template copy of 0x0023A080: stores the byte at self+0xC1C and broadcasts message 8 to group 0 of the field object manager's object lists.
evidence: Same body as 0x0023A080; no callers and class unverified, so the B twin label and maybe_ stay.

name: maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdle
summary: Vtable step: when the UI input manager's slot +0x38 is empty, asks the child at self+8 to switch to state 3 via its virtual +0x14; always returns 1.
evidence: Same four-line body as 0x0029954C/0x004A66D0 with a different unnamed input-manager slot; no caller, so the descriptive name stays maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdleB
summary: Second copy of the idle-advance step: both input-manager slots +0x3C and +0x40 must be empty before the child's virtual +0x14 is called with 3.
evidence: Byte-identical to 0x00249448 apart from testing two input slots; slot names unknown and no caller.

name: maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdleC
signature: int maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdleC(UiWidget* window, int arg2, int b, int c)
summary: Third copy of the idle-advance step, testing input-manager slot +0x34; returns 1 so the caller treats the frame as handled.

name: maybe_Ui_SetupIconHandlesA
summary: Per-screen UI slot-handle setup: gets the UI core and calls Ui_SmithMenu_SetAllSlotHandles(core,1,0x0B), then the still-unnamed setter 0x00625FC0(core,1,1,0x0B). Exact purpose of the pair remains unclear because the second setter is unnamed.
evidence: Calls Ui_GetCore, Ui_SmithMenu_SetAllSlotHandles with category 1 and size 0x0B, then func_00625FC0 with category 1; no callers and no strings to pin the panel.

name: maybe_Ui_SetupIconHandlesB
summary: Same two-step slot-handle setup as 0x00249498 but with category 2 in the second setter call; a per-screen UI handle setup whose exact panel is unknown.
evidence: Identical body to 0x00249498 except func_00625FC0 receives category 2; second setter still unnamed, no callers or strings.
